days.title: High Peaks of the Ligurian Alps
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Punta Marguareis
stops.detail: It takes its name from Punta Marguareis, the highest of the Ligurian Alps.

stops.name: Cima delle Saline
stops.detail: Among the main peaks included in whole or in part in the park, in addition to Marguareis, the Cima delle Saline, Monte Bertrand, Cima Cars, and Cima della Fascia can be mentioned.

days.title: Northern Ridges and Monastic Woodlands
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Certosa di Pesio
stops.detail: The regional park is home to vast wooded areas (in particular beech, fir and larch forests), the development of which was favored by the presence of the monks of the Certosa di Pesio.

stops.name: GTA
stops.detail: A wide network of marked trails is available inside the park, which is also crossed by the southernmost stretch of the GTA.
